questions.title: GATE EE 2016 | GA Question: 2
questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question: A client process P needs to make a TCP connection to a server process S. Consider the following situation: the server process S executes a $\text{socket}$, a $\text{bind}$ and a $\text{listen}$ system call in that order, following which it is preempted. Subsequently, the client process P executes a $\text{socket}$ system call followed by $\text{connect}$ system call to connect to the server process S. The server process has not executed any $\text{accept}$ system call. Which one of the following events could take place?

A client process P needs to make a TCP connection to a server process S. Consider the following situation: the server process S executes a $\text{socket}$, a $\text{bind}$ and a $\text{listen}$ system call in that order, following which it is preempted. Subsequently, the client process P executes a $\text{socket}$ system call followed by $\text{connect}$ system call to connect to the server process S. The server process has not executed any $\text{accept}$ system call. Which one of the following events could take place?

  1. $\text{connect}$ system call returns successfully

  2. $\text{connect}$ system call blocks

  3. $\text{connect}$ system call returns an error

  4. $\text{connect}$ system call results in a core dump

questions.title: GATE EE 2016 | GA Question: 3
questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question:
What is printed by the following C program?

int f(int x, int *py, int **ppz)			
{						                    	
    int y, z;					                		
    **ppz += 1; z = **ppz;		 // corrected z = *ppz; to z = **ppz;                
    *py += 2; y = *py;					                	
    x += 3;					                    	
    return x+y+z;
}

void main
{
    int c, *b, **a;
    c = 4; b = &c; a = &b;
    printf("%d", f(c, b, a));
    	
}

questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question:
Consider the following relational schema:

$\text{Suppliers}(\underline{\text{sid:integer}},\text{ sname:string, city:string, street:string})$ 

$\text{Parts}(\underline{\text{pid:integer}}, \text{ pname:string, color:string})$ 

$\text{Catalog}(\underline {\text{sid:integer, pid:integer}}, \text{cost:real})$

Assume that, in the suppliers relation above, each supplier and each street within a city has unique name, and (sname, city) forms a candidate key. No other functional dependencies are implied other than those implied by primary and candidate keys. Which one of the following is $\text{TRUE}$ about the above schema?

questions.title: GATE EE 2016 | EE Question: 1
questions.subject: Signals & Systems
questions.question: A continuous-time LTI system with impulse response $h(t) = e^{-2t} u(t)$ is:
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Signals & Systems):

Causality: $h(t) = 0$ for $t < 0$ due to $u(t)$. Stability: $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} |h(t)| dt = \int_0^\infty e^{-2t} dt = \left[-\frac{e^{-2t}}{2}\right]_0^\infty = \frac{1}{2} < \infty$. Hence both causal and BIBO stable.

questions.title: GATE EE 2016 | EE Question: 26
questions.subject: Power Electronics & Drives
questions.question: A single-phase full-wave controlled bridge rectifier is fed from a $230\text{ V}$ (RMS), $50\text{ Hz}$ AC source. The firing angle is $\alpha = 60^\circ$. Assuming continuous conduction, the average DC output voltage $V_{dc} = \frac{2 V_m}{\pi} \cos \alpha$ (in Volts) is ________ (round off to one decimal place).
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Power Electronics & Drives):

$V_m = 230 \times \sqrt{2} = 325.27\text{ V}$. $V_{dc} = \frac{2 V_m}{\pi} \cos(60^\circ) = \frac{2 \times 325.27}{\pi} \times 0.5 = \frac{325.27}{3.1416} = 103.54\text{ V}$.

questions.title: GATE EE 2016 | EE Question: 29
questions.subject: Analog & Digital Electronics
questions.question: An ideal op-amp in inverting amplifier configuration has input resistance $R_1 = 10\,\text{k}\Omega$ and feedback resistance $R_f = 100\,\text{k}\Omega$. If input voltage is $V_{\text{in}} = 0.5\text{ V}$, the output voltage $V_{\text{out}} = -\frac{R_f}{R_1} V_{\text{in}}$ (in Volts) is ________.
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Analog & Digital Electronics):

Inverting voltage gain $A_v = -\frac{R_f}{R_1} = -\frac{100}{10} = -10$. Output $V_{\text{out}} = -10 \times 0.5\text{ V} = -5.0\text{ V}$.

questions.rawQuestionHtml:
The iteration formula to find the square root of a positive real number $b$ using the Newton Raphson method is

  1. $x_{k+1} = 3(x_k+b)/2x_k$

  2. $x_{k+1} = (x_{k}^2+b)/2x_k$

  3. $x_{k+1} = x_k-2x_k/\left(x^2_k+b\right)$

  4. None of the above
